name: Small World

key_numbers.label: Race and power combos on display
Tokens to conquer an empty Region

setup.text: Put the map that matches your player count in the middle. Choose by the player-count symbol next to its Game Turn track.
Put the Game Turn marker on the first spot of the track.
Open the storage tray of Race tokens beside the board.

Shuffle the Race banners and lay 5 face up in a column, with the rest stacked at the bottom. Do the same with the Special Power badges and put one beside each banner. The top of the stacks forms a sixth combo.
Put a Lost Tribe token on each Region showing a Lost Tribe symbol.
Put a Mountain token on each Region showing a Mountain.
Keep the remaining coins in a stash beside the board.
The player with the most pointed ears goes first. Play goes clockwise.

turn.summary: First turn: pick a combo, conquer Regions, score. Later turns: expand your race, or put it in decline and pick a new one.
steps: Pick a combo. The top one is free. Each lower one costs 1 more coin, paid by putting a coin on every combo above it. Take any coins already on your pick.
Take Race tokens equal to the banner number plus the badge number. Refill the column so 6 combos show.
Your first conquest with a new race must be a border Region.

To conquer, spend 2 tokens, plus 1 per Encampment, Fortress, Mountain or Troll Lair, plus 1 per Lost Tribe or enemy token there. Each later Region must border one you hold unless a power says otherwise.
On a later turn, leave 1 token in each Region you hold and pick up the rest to use for new conquests.
For your last attempt, if short by 3 or fewer tokens, name the target Region first, then roll the Reinforcement die and add it to the tokens in hand.
Enemies you conquer take back their tokens, permanently discard 1, and redeploy the rest at the end of your turn.
Finish by redeploying your tokens freely among your Regions, leaving at least 1 in each.
Score 1 coin per Region you occupy, plus any bonuses from your active race and power. Declined tokens also score 1 per Region.
To go into decline, flip your banner, keep 1 token flipped in each Region and remove the rest, discard the badge, and score. You make no conquests that turn.

round_end: After everyone has played, the first player moves the Game Turn marker one step.
end: When the marker reaches the last spot, everyone plays one final turn. Then reveal all coins.

scoring.text: Keep your coins hidden. The most coins at the end wins.

tiebreak: Most Race tokens on the board, active and in decline together.

missed.text: You can only have one declined race on the map. Putting a new race into decline removes the old declined tokens first.
A race going into decline cannot conquer anything that turn.
A Region with a Mountain but no tokens counts as empty, but the Mountain still adds 1 to the cost to conquer it.
You must name the target before rolling the Reinforcement die, and the target does not have to be the weakest Region.
You must always keep at least 1 Race token available to start a conquest, whatever your powers.
You may conquer a Region holding your own declined tokens. You lose that token.
Lone Race tokens in a Fortress or on a Mountain, or with a Troll Lair, count as alone for the Sorcerer power.

not_covered: Which map and Lost Tribe or Mountain layout belongs to each player count.
Race tokens per player and the number of game turns for each count; the rulebook gives these as pictures.
unverified: Game turn counts (8, 9 or 10) per player count: the text only says it depends on the map.
